en.topic_title: Migrant worker groups urge higher pay and local training for proposed domestic carer scheme
en.topic_summary:
Foreign domestic workers hired under a planned government elderly caregiving scheme should be paid more and allowed to complete training in Hong Kong rather than in their home countries, migrant worker activists have urged.



Migrant domestic workers in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
